exam_scheme.note: Indira Gandhi Institute of Development Research (IGIDR), Mumbai, an advanced research institute established by the Reserve Bank of India (RBI) and recognized as an autonomous Deemed to be University under Section 3 of the UGC Act, conducts admissions to its 2-year full-time Master of Science in Economics (M.Sc. Economics) through a national entrance examination (CUET-PG / IGIDR Entrance Test) followed by faculty interviews. The curriculum emphasizes rigorous quantitative economics, microeconomics, macroeconomics, and econometrics.
